---
title: "Glossary"
as_of: "2026-09-07"
---

Use the browser find function (Ctrl+F or ⌘F). Official = you may cite. Course = lecture model. Industry usage = vocabulary, not Hong Kong law.

## Hong Kong institutions and law

**Action Plan on Developing Low-Altitude Economy**  
Kind: Official  
2025 PA ¶154; text OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 11–12.

**advanced operations (进阶操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA operations that require prior CAD permission under Cap. 448G (as distinct from ordinary permitted flying). Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

**Advanced Operations Permission (进阶操作许可)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD permission under Cap. 448G s.37 to conduct an advanced operation (e.g. Sandbox BVLOS or Sandbox X cross-boundary). Cap. 448G s.37; CAD AC-013 §4.2; AC-017. Week 7.

**Advanced Rating (进阶级别)**  
Kind: Official  
Rating assigned with a remote pilot certificate for more demanding SUA operations; AC-013 requires it for Sandbox BVLOS remote pilots. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §8.1–8.2. Week 7.

**Advisory Circular (顾问通告)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD guidance document (e.g. AC-013 Sandbox BVLOS; AC-017 Sandbox X cross-boundary) — guidance, not Cap. 448G itself. CAD ACs. Week 7.

**ATMD (CAD) (航空交通管理部)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD Air Traffic Management Division; AC-017 normally requires time-slot requests ≥5 working days before Sandbox X cross-boundary flights. CAD AC-017 §4.3. Week 8.

**CAD (民航处)**  
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong Civil Aviation Department — Cap. 448G regulator and issuer of sandbox Advisory Circulars. Cap. 448G; CAD. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Cap. 448C pathway (《1995年飞航（香港）令》(第448C章))**  
Kind: Official  
Air Navigation (Hong Kong) Order 1995 — used with Cap. 448G when heavier / unconventional trial flying needs provisions outside the SUA Order alone. Cap. 448C; 2024–2025 PA LAE legislative track. Week 7 / Week 11.

**Dangerous goods (SUA) (危险品)**  
Kind: Official  
Goods or substances within Cap. 295 as applied by Cap. 448G; SUA must not carry them in flight unless permission is obtained. Cap. 448G; Cap. 295; CAD AC-013 §6.6. Week 7.

**HKCA 1072**  
Kind: Official  
Do **not** map to the 1.4 GHz UAS (Private) Licence (GN-1/2025). HKCA 1072 Iss.2 (Aug 2026) is E-UTRA base station — different instrument. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

**LAE insurance task force**  
Kind: Official  
Industry group using Sandbox data. 2025 PA ¶157. Week 6.

**OFCA / Communications Authority (通讯办 / 通讯事务管理局)**  
Kind: Official  
Spectrum licensing authority for the UAS (Private) Licence (with the Communications Authority). OFCA / CA. Week 7.

**Regulatory Sandbox (监管沙盒)**  
Kind: Official  
First-cohort Hong Kong trial programme. Applications from 13 November 2024; 38 of 72 proposals selected (TLB/GIA, 20 March 2025). BVLOS in this programme is covered by CAD AC-013. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Regulatory Sandbox X (监管沙盒X)**  
Kind: Official  
Advanced programme launched 24 November 2025. Separate from the first Sandbox. Module batches reported as UTM 15, unconventional aircraft 4, shared platform 5, others 9; cross-boundary results still open. CAD AC-017 covers cross-boundary operations in Sandbox X. Week 1 / Week 7.

**Remote pilot certificate (遥控驾驶员证书)**  
Kind: Official  
Certificate issued under Cap. 448G after required training/assessment for registered remote pilots. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §8. Week 7.

**Responsible person (负责人)**  
Kind: Official  
Person responsible for the SUA under Cap. 448G (registration/labelling and compliance duties alongside the remote pilot). Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**Safety Requirements Document (SRD) (安全规定文件)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD document issued under Cap. 448G s.63 setting detailed SUA safety requirements; ACs are read with the Order and the SRD. Cap. 448G s.63; CAD AC-013 §18.2; AC-017 §11.2. Week 7.

**Small Unmanned Aircraft Order, Cap. 448G (小型无人驾驶飞机令)**  
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong statute for small unmanned aircraft. Full effect 1 December 2022; Category C up to 150 kg from 18 July 2025. Week 7.

**TLB (运输及物流局)**  
Kind: Official  
Transport and Logistics Bureau; policy bureau supporting the Working Group secretariat and LAE sandbox communications. TLB / WG materials. Week 1.

**Unconventional aircraft**  
Kind: Official  
Intended dedicated rules for craft over 150 kg; legislation OPEN. 2025 PA ¶154. Week 7.

**Working Group (发展低空经济工作组)**  
Kind: Official  
Cross-government group headed by the Deputy Financial Secretary; first meeting 2024-11-12. 2024 PA ¶82; GIA 2024-11-12. Week 1.

## Mainland comparators

**CAAC ATM Rules (draft) / 《民用航空空中交通管理规则（征求意见稿）》**  
Kind: Official  
NEW watch term. Published **2026-08-11**; comments to **2026-09-11**; Chapter 12 无人驾驶航空器. Not yet law. (WEEKLY-2026-09-05)

**CCAR-92 (《民用无人驾驶航空器运行安全管理规则》)**  
Kind: Official  
CAAC civil aviation regulation on UAS operational safety; effective **2024-01-01**. CCAR-92 / MOT publication. Week 7.

**Civil Aviation Law (2025 revision) (中华人民共和国民用航空法（2025年修订）)**  
Kind: Official  
Revised PRC Civil Aviation Law (Order No. 65); passed 2025-12-27; effective **2026-07-01**; detailed UAS operating rules still rest on State Council / CAAC instruments until further rules are made. Order No. 65; CAAC. Week 7.

**Class G / W (G类 / W类空域)**  
Kind: Official  
Mainland national airspace classification labels (2023 release); **not Hong Kong law**. CAAC National Airspace Basic Classification (2023-12-21). Week 8.

**低空经济 (NDRC statistical / industrial-policy term) (低空经济)**  
Kind: Official  
Mainland statistical and industrial-policy scope per NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号 (2025-12-22) — **not** the same metric as OHKF Hong Kong industry value-added. NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号. Week 1 / Week 9.

**国令761 (无人驾驶航空器飞行管理暂行条例)**  
Kind: Official  
State Council Interim UAS Flight Management Ordinance; effective **2024-01-01** — Mainland ops baseline with CCAR-92. 国令761. Week 7.

## Vehicles and operations

**300 ft AGL operating limit (离地高度300英尺限制)**  
Kind: Official  
Default Cap. 448G / SRD operating requirement that SUA stay at or below 300 ft above ground level unless permission allows otherwise. Cap. 448G / SRD; CAD AC-013 §6.1. Week 7.

**Air risk (空中风险)**  
Kind: Official  
Risk of collision or conflict with other airspace users during the SUA flight. CAD AC-013 §4.3(f). Week 7 / Week 8.

**Automatic operation (自动操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA follows pre-determined routes, but the remote pilot must still be able to intervene for unforeseen events. CAD AC-013 §2.1. Week 7.

**Autonomous operation (自主操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA flies without the remote pilot being able to intervene; **not allowed** for Sandbox BVLOS under AC-013. CAD AC-013 §2.2, §6.7. Week 7.

**BVLOS (超视距)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation beyond the remote pilot’s visual line of sight; in the first Regulatory Sandbox, the relevant circular is CAD AC-013. CAD AC-013; Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**C2 link (指挥与控制链路)**  
Kind: Official  
Command-and-control communications link between the remote pilot / ground systems and the SUA. CAD AC-013 §5.5; AC-017 §5. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Category A / B / C (Cap. 448G) (甲类 / 乙类 / 丙类)**  
Kind: Official  
Weight-based SUA classes under Cap. 448G; Category C covers above 25 kg up to 150 kg (from 2025-07-18). Cap. 448G (Cat C expansion 2025-07-18). Week 7.

**Congested area (人口稠密地区)**  
Kind: Official  
Built-up area where BVLOS routes that raise ground risk should normally be avoided unless justified to CAD. CAD AC-013 §5.2; Cap. 448G operating context. Week 7.

**Containment (空域／航迹约束)**  
Kind: Official  
Keeping the SUA entirely inside the pre-defined sandbox operating areas or routes by technology and/or procedures. CAD AC-013 §4.3(d), §5.3. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Cross-boundary SUA operation (跨境小型无人驾驶飞机操作)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA flight that is **not** wholly within Hong Kong; Cap. 448G treats it as an advanced operation needing CAD permission — AC-017 covers Sandbox X cross-boundary (no person on board). Cap. 448G s.16(1A); CAD AC-017. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Daylight-only default (日间飞行默认要求)**  
Kind: Official  
Default operating requirement to fly SUA only in daylight hours unless a relevant permission is obtained. Cap. 448G / SRD; CAD AC-013 §6.1. Week 7.

**Detect and avoid (DAA) (探测与避让)**  
Kind: Official  
Capability to see, sense or detect conflicting traffic or other hazards and take appropriate action — concept only, no product brand. CAD AC-013 §2.3. Week 7 / Week 8.

**docking station (机库 / 起降柜)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Ground unit for automated launch, recovery, charging or swapping of small unmanned aircraft; CAD AC-016 addresses hangar/dock-style SUA operations — **not** a vertiport statute. CAD AC-016; industry usage. Week 5 / Week 7.

**EVLOS (扩展视距)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation beyond simple VLOS but still using visual observers or procedures — not BVLOS. CAD / Cap. 448G practice. Week 7.

**eVTOL (电动垂直起降飞行器)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft; in Hong Kong, passenger-carrying / heavy types sit above the Cap. 448G 150 kg SUA ceiling and are treated as unconventional aircraft pending dedicated rules — **no dedicated HK eVTOL statute yet**. Cap. 448G ceiling; 2025 PA ¶154 unconventional-aircraft pathway (OPEN). Week 7 / Week 5.

**Flight critical system (FCS) (飞行关键系统)**  
Kind: Official  
System whose failure could be catastrophic or stop the SUA sustaining flight (e.g. flight control, propulsion, navigation). CAD AC-013 §2.4. Week 7.

**Flight log (飞行记录)**  
Kind: Official  
Required safety-system record of flight data; AC-013 requires retention (with other safety-system info) for six months and accessibility in Hong Kong for advanced operations. Cap. 448G s.13; CAD AC-013 §10.1. Week 7.

**Flight termination (飞行终止)**  
Kind: Official  
Procedure or system that ends the flight as soon as practicable in an emergency. CAD AC-013 §9.4. Week 7.

**Geo-awareness (地理感知)**  
Kind: Official  
SUA safety-system function that supports awareness of geographical limits; required with flight log under Cap. 448G s.13 / AC-013. Cap. 448G s.13; CAD AC-013 §10.1. Week 7.

**Geo-fence / geo-fencing (电子围栏)**  
Kind: Official  
Electronic or procedural boundary that keeps the SUA inside pre-defined sandbox operating areas or flight routes. CAD AC-013 §5.3, App. A §3.6. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Ground risk (地面风险)**  
Kind: Official  
Risk to people, vehicles, vessels or structures on the ground from the SUA flight. CAD AC-013 §4.3(f), §5.2. Week 7.

**Interoperability / standards**  
Kind: Course  
Ability of vehicles, UTM and sites to work to a common rule set; cite PA infrastructure language only. Course / 2025 PA. Week 11–12.

**Involved person (相关人员)**  
Kind: Official  
Person who takes part in or is briefed on the SUA operation, understands the risks, and follows safety instructions. CAD AC-013 §2.5.1. Week 7.

**MTOW (最大起飞重量)**  
Kind: Official  
Maximum certified take-off weight; Cap. 448G categories and Mainland UAS rules key off weight thresholds. Cap. 448G; Mainland UAS instruments. Week 7.

**Operations Manual (OM) (操作手册)**  
Kind: Official  
Operator document setting organisation, procedures, emergency response and maintenance for the proposed advanced / sandbox operation. CAD AC-013 App. A; AC-017 §9.1. Week 7.

**payload (有效载荷)**  
Kind: Course  
Mass or cargo carried for the mission, distinct from empty weight or MTOW. Course. Week 3 / Week 7.

**Remote ID (远程识别)**  
Kind: Official  
Continuous broadcast of SUA identity and geographic position so aircraft in the air can be identified. CAD AC-017 §8.2. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Remote pilot (遥控驾驶员)**  
Kind: Official  
Person who manipulates the flight controls of a SUA during flight under Cap. 448G. Cap. 448G; CAD AC-013 §7. Week 7.

**Return-to-home (RTH) (返航)**  
Kind: Official  
Pre-programmed recovery behaviour that sends the SUA to a home or safe site (e.g. after C2-link loss); incorrect RTH settings are a containment hazard. CAD AC-013 §14.1. Week 7.

**SUA (小型无人驾驶飞机)**  
Kind: Official  
Hong Kong Cap. 448G term for small unmanned aircraft in the Order’s weight classes — not a global synonym for every drone. Cap. 448G. Week 7.

**Surveillance system (监视系统)**  
Kind: Official  
Means (or alternative compliance) for the remote pilot to monitor the SUA and nearby traffic/obstacles during higher-risk BVLOS. CAD AC-013 §10.9. Week 7 / Week 8.

**UAS (无人驾驶航空器系统)**  
Kind: Official  
Unmanned aircraft system (aircraft + control station + links); used in OFCA licence titles and Mainland instruments; broader than Cap. 448G “SUA.”. OFCA UAS (Private) Licence; Mainland 国令761 / CCAR-92 usage. Week 7.

**UAV (无人驾驶航空器 / 无人机)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Common label for the aircraft alone; prefer **SUA** when citing Cap. 448G and **UAS** when citing system or spectrum rules. Course / industry usage. Week 7.

**Uninvolved person (非相关人员)**  
Kind: Official  
Any person other than an involved person; drives ground-risk planning for BVLOS. CAD AC-013 §2.5.2. Week 7.

**Visual observer (VO) (视觉观察员)**  
Kind: Official  
Person at the same location as the remote pilot who keeps unaided visual contact with the SUA and communicates to help avoid collision. CAD AC-013 §2.6.1. Week 7.

**VLOS (视距内)**  
Kind: Official  
Operation in which the remote pilot (or observer) keeps the aircraft in unaided visual sight. Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

**VTOL (垂直起降)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Vertical take-off and landing as a flight capability, whether electric or not; broader than eVTOL. Course / industry usage. Week 7.

## Airspace and traffic

**corridor (航廊 / 低空走廊)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
A defined low-altitude route volume used in policy and sandbox language (including cross-boundary concepts); a planned or trial corridor is not proof of an operating SZ–HK medical corridor. Sandbox X / TLB cross-boundary language; Tracker: corridor **operational** NOT evidenced. Week 8 / Week 4.

**HKAIP special-use airspace (航空资料汇编特殊使用空域)**  
Kind: Official  
Prohibited, Restricted or Danger Areas published in the Hong Kong Aeronautical Information Publication — Sandbox BVLOS routes must stay clear unless justified. CAD AC-013 §5.1; HKAIP. Week 8.

**restricted flying zone (CAD) (限制飞行区)**  
Kind: Official  
CAD-designated area where SUA flight is restricted or needs permission; cite current CAD maps/notices, not press maps. CAD. Week 7 / Week 8.

**Smart low-altitude traffic management (智能低空交通管理)**  
Kind: Official  
Policy-Address label for the planned digital traffic-management layer of low-altitude infrastructure; Hong Kong system still **planned**, not a statute. 2024 PA LAE infra slide; 2025 PA ¶154. Week 8 / Week 5.

**U-space (（欧盟用语，无标准港译）)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
EU / industry label for a set of UAS traffic services; **not Hong Kong law** — do not write that Hong Kong has U-space. EU U-space framework (industry comparator). Week 8.

**UTM (无人驾驶航空器交通管理)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Unmanned aircraft system traffic management; Hong Kong’s smart low-altitude traffic-management system is **planned** infrastructure (2025 PA) — **not yet a Hong Kong statute**. 2025 PA ¶154; Sandbox X UTM demos. Week 8.

**visual line of sight (视线可见 / 视距)**  
Kind: Official  
Plain-language pair to VLOS: keeping the aircraft in unaided sight; use the VLOS entry for Cap. 448G citations. Cap. 448G / CAD. Week 7.

## Infrastructure

**1.4 GHz / UAS (Private) Licence (无人驾驶飞机（专用）牌照（1430–1444 MHz）)**  
Kind: Official  
Dedicated UAS spectrum band 1430–1444 MHz, licensable for LAE Regulatory Sandbox projects from 2025-10-27 — not a general public mobile band. CA / OFCA; GN-1/2025. Week 7.

**charging / swapping (充电 / 换电)**  
Kind: Course  
Energy logistics for electric SUA or eVTOL at sites or docks; course infrastructure concept, not a licence by itself. Course. Week 5.

**Low-altitude infrastructure (PA) (低空基础设施)**  
Kind: Official  
PA package covering GNSS, mobile radio, high-speed data, take-off/landing and charging facilities, plus traffic management — planning language, not a built network inventory. 2024 PA LAE; 2025 PA ¶154–155. Week 5 / Week 8.

**Throughput**  
Kind: Course  
Movements a site can handle per hour after safety separation. Course. Week 5.

**Vertiport (垂直起降场 / 起降点（政策用语）)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Take-off and landing site for advanced low-altitude craft; 2025 Policy Address names planning of such sites — **Hong Kong has no dedicated vertiport statute yet** (do not invent one). 2025 PA ¶154; text of Action Plan OPEN. Week 5.

**vertistop (小型起降点)**  
Kind: Industry usage  
Industry term for a lighter pad than a full vertiport; **not a Hong Kong statutory category**. Industry usage. Week 5.

## Business and economics

**ASK / available capacity unit (可用座位（或载荷）公里)**  
Kind: Course  
Capacity supplied (seat-km or payload-km) used as the denominator in CASK/CPMK — course accounting identity only; no lecture numbers on the public site. Course models (W3). Week 3.

**Break-even load factor (盈亏平衡载运率)**  
Kind: Course  
Load factor at which revenue covers a stated cost block; course planning tool — worked classroom numbers stay off the public site. Course models (W3). Week 3.

**CAPEX / OPEX (资本开支 / 营运开支)**  
Kind: Course  
Upfront capital expenditure versus recurring operating expenditure. Course. Week 3.

**CASK / CPMK (可用座位公里成本 / 可用载荷公里成本)**  
Kind: Course  
Cost per available seat-kilometre or per available payload-kilometre — lecture worked examples are not data. Course. Week 3.

**economies of density (密度经济)**  
Kind: Course  
Average cost falls as more flights share the same corridor or vertiport. Course. Week 2.

**externality (外部性)**  
Kind: Course  
Noise, risk, privacy or carbon cost not priced into the ticket or fee. Course. Week 10.

**generalised cost (广义成本)**  
Kind: Course  
Money cost plus time valued at the traveller’s value of time. Course. Week 4.

**HHI (赫芬达尔—赫希曼指数)**  
Kind: Course  
Sum of squared market shares; classroom calculations stay off the public site. Course. Week 2.

**Industry value-added (产业增加值)**  
Kind: Course  
Accounting concept used by Our Hong Kong Foundation for the ~HK$350 billion figure: Hong Kong only, horizon 2050, September 2025 report. Not government output and not a Mainland 规模 total. Week 1 / Week 9.

**load factor (载运率)**  
Kind: Course  
Traffic carried divided by capacity offered (seats or payload). Course. Week 3.

**NASA UAM market study constraints**  
Kind: Course  
Legal, weather, infrastructure and acceptance shrink the unconstrained market. NASA 2018. Week 4.

**Pigovian instrument**  
Kind: Course  
Tax, charge or subsidy aimed at that externality; Hong Kong has no drone congestion tax in force. Course. Week 10.

**platform / FaaS (平台 / 飞行即服务)**  
Kind: Course  
Matching or fly-as-a-service model, as distinct from owning the fleet. Course. Week 6.

**PPP (公私营合作)**  
Kind: Course  
Public–private partnership for infrastructure or services — **not** a substitute for a vertiport statute. Course. Week 5 / Week 11.

**Social license (社会许可)**  
Kind: Course  
Informal community acceptance that can constrain routes even when legal permission exists. Course models (W10). Week 10.

**Supporting services**  
Kind: Industry usage  
The segment that accounts for most of the 2050 value-added projection. OHKF. Week 1.

**unconstrained versus constrained market (无约束市场 对比 受约束市场)**  
Kind: Course  
Theoretical demand versus demand after legal, weather, infrastructure and acceptance barriers (NASA UAM framing). NASA UAM market study (2018). Week 4 / Week 9.

**Value chain (价值链)**  
Kind: Course  
Stages from vehicle and infrastructure to operations and supporting services. Course. Week 1.

**Value of time (时间价值)**  
Kind: Course  
Shadow price of passenger or shipper time used inside generalised cost — lecture numbers stay off the public site. Course. Week 4.

**value-added versus 规模 (增加值 对比 规模)**  
Kind: Course  
OHKF-style industry **value-added** is not the same metric as Mainland **规模** (scale) totals. OHKF (T3); NDRC / CCID scale figures. Week 9.

**yield (收益（客公里／吨公里）)**  
Kind: Course  
Revenue per traffic unit (e.g. per passenger-km or payload-km) — no classroom ticket prices on the public site. Course. Week 3.

## Unplaced

- Interoperability / standards
